answers.question: What is the primary goal when inspecting HazMat tanker shell construction, baffles, manways, and compartments?
answers.selected: Containment — preventing hazardous release
answers.correctAnswer: Containment — preventing hazardous release

answers.question: Which components are described as common high-risk leak sources on HazMat tankers?
answers.selected: Internal/external valves, bottom outlets, emergency shutoffs, gaskets, seals, and caps
answers.correctAnswer: Internal/external valves, bottom outlets, emergency shutoffs, gaskets, seals, and caps

answers.question: What is the function of Pressure & Vacuum Relief Devices (PRDs) on a tanker?
answers.selected: To prevent overpressure or shell collapse during loading, unloading, or temperature-driven expansion/contraction
answers.correctAnswer: To prevent overpressure or shell collapse during loading, unloading, or temperature-driven expansion/contraction

answers.question: Per 49 CFR 180.407, how often is the External Visual Inspection (V) required on a cargo tank?
answers.selected: Annually (every 1 year)
answers.correctAnswer: Annually (every 1 year)

answers.question: Per 49 CFR 180.407, how often is the Pressure Test (P) required?
answers.selected: Every 5 years
answers.correctAnswer: Every 5 years

answers.question: Per 49 CFR 180.407, how often is the Thickness Test (T) required?
answers.selected: Every 5 years
answers.correctAnswer: Every 2 years

answers.question: Why does preventative maintenance matter for spill prevention?
answers.selected: It reduces spill risk through secondary containment integrity, drip prevention, and early leak-path identification
answers.correctAnswer: It reduces spill risk through secondary containment integrity, drip prevention, and early leak-path identification

answers.question: Under 49 CFR trailer body damage standards, what is the maximum allowable dent/gouge depth at a weld?
answers.selected: 1/2 inch
answers.correctAnswer: 1/2 inch

answers.question: What must happen if a weld or structural defect (crack, pinhole, incomplete fusion) is found on a cargo tank?
answers.selected: The tank must be taken out of HazMat service until repaired
answers.correctAnswer: The tank must be taken out of HazMat service until repaired

answers.question: What is required before returning a tank to HazMat service if any source of leakage is found?
answers.selected: All sources of leakage must be properly repaired
answers.correctAnswer: All sources of leakage must be properly repaired

answers.question: What is the primary purpose of the cargo tank shell?
answers.selected: To contain the product while withstanding internal pressure, surge, vibration, temperature change, and vehicle movement
answers.correctAnswer: To contain the product while withstanding internal pressure, surge, vibration, temperature change, and vehicle movement

answers.question: What do the front and rear heads of a cargo tank do?
answers.selected: Strengthen the tank and resist pressure loads
answers.correctAnswer: Strengthen the tank and resist pressure loads

answers.question: Why do baffles reduce risk during braking, acceleration, and turning?
answers.selected: They slow liquid movement inside the tank, improving braking, steering control, and reducing rollover risk
answers.correctAnswer: They slow liquid movement inside the tank, improving braking, steering control, and reducing rollover risk

answers.question: What is the main purpose of bulkheads in a cargo tank?
answers.selected: To divide the tank into compartments, separating products, preventing contamination, and reducing surge
answers.correctAnswer: To divide the tank into compartments, separating products, preventing contamination, and reducing surge

answers.question: Since baffles are internal, how do technicians verify their condition?
answers.selected: Through scheduled internal inspections required by 49 CFR 180.407
answers.correctAnswer: Through scheduled internal inspections required by 49 CFR 180.407

answers.question: What does leakage around a manway indicate?
answers.selected: That the sealing system has failed
answers.correctAnswer: That the sealing system has failed

answers.question: Why is a bottom outlet assembly considered especially vulnerable?
answers.selected: It is exposed underneath the cargo tank and prone to road impact, corrosion, and damaged threads
answers.correctAnswer: It is exposed underneath the cargo tank and prone to road impact, corrosion, and damaged threads

answers.question: What should you check when inspecting internal valves?

answers.correctAnswer: Valve movement, return spring, seat condition, leakage, linkage, and actuator

answers.question: When is an external valve considered unsafe?

answers.correctAnswer: When it will not fully close

answers.question: What should technicians inspect gaskets, seals, and O-rings for?

answers.correctAnswer: Hardening, swelling, cracking, compression set, cuts, and chemical deterioration
